notes: RTT-003 design pilot, ROUND 2 (IQ-10; Luke's answers and changes of 2 Oct 2026, DEC-114 onwards). The full film is NOT rendered; this config defines it so the pilot clips (which extend it) and the length estimate come from one place. Drawn by the RTT-002 player (kits/rtt-002) in its quarter-end series mode; every RTT-003 feature is switched on here and is off for RTT-002.

Round 2: 15 rows (DEC-116, Xbox One appears from mid-2017); numbers count smoothly and land on the exact series.csv value on every quarter-end frame (count, DEC-118); the maker's logo beside each picture (bar_logos, DEC-119); no separate maker key - the bottom-right panel is the company scoreboard (kept, DEC-114) with its legend; tall pictures may use 1.2x the box height (pictures.tall_frac, DEC-120); callouts at the three crown changes plus Game Boy first past 100 million and DS passes Game Boy (moments, DEC-117; Switch passes DS on hold); final-table line and PS2 footnote (final_line, final_footnote, DEC-117).

Approved design (DEC-085) and round-1 choices DEC-106..DEC-111 as confirmed by Luke (names, maker colours, estimated look, fade, crown, title, pacing approach). Board 70 px lower than RTT-002's (board_top 220) to make room for the callout line and the final-table footnote.

pacing: RTT-002's rule (DEC-068) on quarter ends: sec_per_event 1.0 s x 1.4 / 1.0 / 0.8 judged on the 15 rows; quarter ends up to 31 Dec 1988 at 0.5 s (DEC-097); 2.0 s hold on each change of first place; final table 10 s (DEC-070). Clip A is also rendered at 1.5 s (config_rtt003_clip_A_1985_1992_1.5x.json) for Luke to compare (DEC-121).

No music (DEC-115: the RTT-002 approach with a new track later). Pictures and logos are private (race-through-time-private assets/rtt-003/icons, logos; DEC-060), loaded from RTT_LOCAL_ASSETS; never committed here.
